cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a GIS Spatial Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Collects, edits, and processes GIS and mapping data from various sources to produce tools and products which meet internal and external customer requirements.
Import, export, and convert mapping resources and data into GIS systems and platforms.
Utilizes Feature Manipulation Engine platform(s) to translate spatial data between geometric & digital formats.
Performs quality control checks on completed projects.
Perform on-going, periodic tasks related to geospatial database maintenance.
Prepares and submits reports of project updates, as needed.
Performs a wide variety of advanced process and analysis functions to develop the City's geographic information system (GIS) and is responsible for its operation, administration and information quality and integrity.
Provides technical consultation to a wide range of technical and non-technical employees using the GIS to compile reports and studies.
Responsible for documentation and ensures the integrity and security of the data stored in the GIS and related/integrated databases.
Key contact for GIS within the project team.
Completion of tasks received from engineers and the GIS manager.
Integration of data from multiple sources into the spatial data repository.
Conducts analysis, interrogation and manipulation of spatial data received from stakeholders and third parties.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or GED
Experience using ESRI ArcGIS
Skilled in ESRI ArcGIS extensions: 3D, Spatial, Network and Tracking Analyst
Deep understanding of spatial data formats and spatial reference systems
Experience of providing GIS support to multidiscipline, client focused, project environments
Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel
Proven experience of delivering to deadlines within pressurized environments
Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English
Proficiency with database programming languages such as SQL, R or Python
Ability to analyze problems and perform needs assessments
Strong judgment in adapting broad guidelines to achieve desired result
Preferred Requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Geography, Surveying, Engineering or a degree qualification in GIS
Proficiency with front end design languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and various mapping languages
Experience with mapping tools such as QGIS and Carto (3+ years)
Experience with GPS measuring tools (3+ years)
Experience of working with and controlling a large number of evolving datasets (3+ years)
Experience using FME Desktop and Server (3+ years)
Experience using AutoCAD software including Civil 3D and Map (3+ years)

cond_0253.intro: We are looking for a GIS Spatial Analyst to join our team.

Collects, edits, and processes GIS and mapping data from various sources to produce tools and products which meet internal and external customer requirements.
Import, export, and convert mapping resources and data into GIS systems and platforms.

Integration of data from multiple sources into the spatial data repository.

High School Diploma or GED
Experience using ESRI ArcGIS
Skilled in ESRI ArcGIS extensions: 3D, Spatial, Network and Tracking Analyst

Experience of providing GIS support to multidiscipline, client focused, project environments
Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel
Proven experience of delivering to deadlines within pressurized environments
Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English
Proficiency with database programming languages such as SQL, R or Python
Ability to analyze problems and perform needs assessments

cond_0262.intro: This role provides analytical support for a variety of projects which aim to streamline the mapping and design process. The GIS Analyst analyzes information by using various criteria, integrating GIS with other technologies, designing databases, and collaborating with CAD technicians. A GIS analyst reads geographical data, enters it into the GIS system, and performs data analysis.
cond_0262.responsibilities:
Collects, edits, and processes GIS and mapping data from various sources to produce tools and products which meet internal and external customer requirements.
Import, export, and convert mapping resources and data into GIS systems and platforms.
Utilizes Feature Manipulation Engine platform(s) to translate spatial data between geometric & digital formats.
Performs quality control checks on completed projects.
Perform on-going, periodic tasks related to geospatial database maintenance.
Prepares and submits reports of project updates, as needed.
Performs a wide variety of advanced process and analysis functions to develop the geographic information system (GIS) and is responsible for its operation, administration and information quality and integrity.
Provides technical consultation to a wide range of technical and non-technical employees using the GIS to compile reports and studies.
Responsible for documentation and ensures the integrity and security of the data stored in the GIS and related/integrated databases.
Key contact for GIS within the project team.
Completion of tasks received from engineers and the GIS manager.
Integration of data from multiple sources into the spatial data repository.
Conducts analysis, interrogation and manipulation of spatial data received from stakeholders and third parties.
cond_0262.requirements:
Experience using ESRI ArcGIS
Skilled in ESRI ArcGIS extensions: 3D, Spatial, Network and Tracking Analyst.
Experience of providing GIS support to multidiscipline, client focused, project environments.
Deep understanding of spatial data formats and spatial reference systems.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.
Proven experience of delivering to deadlines within pressurized environments.
Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English.
Proficiency with database programming languages such as SQL, R or Python.
Proficiency with front end design languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and various mapping languages.
Ability to analyze problems and perform needs assessments.
Strong judgment in adapting broad guidelines to achieve desired result.
High School Diploma or GED
Experience with mapping tools such as QGIS and Carto 3+
Experience with GPS measuring tools 3+
Experience of working with and controlling a large number of evolving datasets 3+
Experience using FME Desktop and Server 3+
Experience using AutoCAD software (including Civil 3D and Map) 3+
Hands on experience of using CAD derived data within a GIS environment 3+
Degree in Computer Science, Geography, Surveying, Engineering or a degree qualification in GIS

cond_0331.intro: The GIS Analyst role provides analytical support for projects aimed at streamlining the mapping and design process. The analyst works with geographical data, enters it into the GIS system, integrates GIS with other technologies, designs databases, and coordinates with CAD technicians.
cond_0331.responsibilities:
Collects, edits, and processes GIS and mapping data from various sources to produce tools and products meeting internal and external customer requirements.
Imports, exports, and converts mapping resources and data into GIS systems and platforms.
Uses Feature Manipulation Engine platform(s) to translate spatial data between geometric and digital formats.
Performs quality control checks on completed projects.
Carries out periodic tasks related to geospatial database maintenance.
Prepares and submits project update reports as needed.
Performs advanced process and analysis functions to develop and maintain the geographic information system, including its operation, administration, and data quality and integrity.
Provides technical guidance to technical and non-technical staff using the GIS to compile reports and studies.
Maintains documentation and ensures the integrity and security of data stored in the GIS and related databases.
Serves as the GIS point of contact within the project team.
Completes tasks received from engineers and the GIS manager.
Integrates data from multiple sources into the spatial data repository.
Conducts analysis, interrogation, and manipulation of spatial data received from stakeholders and third parties.
cond_0331.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or GED
Experience using ESRI ArcGIS
Skilled in ESRI ArcGIS extensions: 3D, Spatial, Network, and Tracking Analyst
Deep understanding of spatial data formats and spatial reference systems
Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel
Ability to analyze problems and perform needs assessments
Strong judgment in adapting broad guidelines to achieve desired results
Excellent written and spoken English communication skills
Experience providing GIS support in multidiscipline, client-focused project environments
Proven experience delivering to deadlines in pressurized environments
Preferred Requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Geography, Surveying, Engineering, or GIS
Proficiency with database programming languages such as SQL, R, or Python
Proficiency with front-end design languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and various mapping languages
3+ Years experience with mapping tools such as QGIS and Carto
3+ Years experience with GPS measuring tools
3+ Years experience working with and managing a large number of evolving datasets
3+ Years experience using FME Desktop and Server
3+ Years experience using AutoCAD software (including Civil 3D and Map)
Hands-on experience using CAD-derived data within a GIS environment

cond_0350.intro: The GIS Analyst role provides analytical support for a variety of projects aimed at streamlining the mapping and design process. The analyst takes ownership of geographic data — reading, entering, and analyzing it within the GIS system — while integrating GIS with other technologies, designing databases, and working alongside CAD technicians.
cond_0350.responsibilities:
Collect, edit, and process GIS and mapping data from various sources to deliver tools and products that meet internal and external customer requirements.
Drive the import, export, and conversion of mapping resources and data into GIS systems and platforms.
Execute spatial data translation between geometric and digital formats using Feature Manipulation Engine platform(s).
Lead quality control checks on completed projects.
Own ongoing, periodic tasks related to geospatial database maintenance.
Prepare and submit project update reports as needed.
Execute a wide variety of advanced process and analysis functions to develop the City's geographic information system (GIS), taking full accountability for its operation, administration, and data quality and integrity.
Deliver technical consultation to a wide range of technical and non-technical staff using the GIS to compile reports and studies.
Ensure the integrity and security of data stored in the GIS and related/integrated databases, and maintain thorough documentation.
Serve as the key GIS contact within the project team.
Execute tasks received from engineers and the GIS manager.
Drive the integration of data from multiple sources into the spatial data repository.
Lead the analysis, interrogation, and manipulation of spatial data received from stakeholders and third parties.
cond_0350.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience using ESRI ArcGIS
Skilled in ESRI ArcGIS extensions: 3D, Spatial, Network and Tracking Analyst
Deep understanding of spatial data formats and spatial reference systems
Proficiency with database programming languages such as SQL, R or Python
Ability to analyze problems and perform needs assessments
Strong judgment in adapting broad guidelines to achieve desired results
High School Diploma or GED
Experience with mapping tools such as QGIS and Carto (3+ years)
Experience with GPS measuring tools (3+ years)
Experience working with and controlling a large number of evolving datasets (3+ years)
Preferred Requirements
Experience providing GIS support to multidiscipline, client-focused project environments
Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel
Proven experience delivering to deadlines within pressurized environments
Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English
Proficiency with front-end design languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and various mapping languages
Experience using FME Desktop and Server (3+ years)
Experience using AutoCAD software including Civil 3D and Map (3+ years)
Hands-on experience using CAD-derived data within a GIS environment (3+ years)
Degree in Computer Science, Geography, Surveying, Engineering, or a qualification in GIS
A qualified applicant's criminal history, if any, will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable laws, including local ordinances.

Collects, edits, and processes GIS and mapping data from various sources to produce tools and products which meet internal and external customer requirements.
Import, export, and convert mapping resources and data into GIS systems and platforms.
Utilizes Feature Manipulation Engine platform(s) to translate spatial data between geometric & digital formats.
Performs quality control checks on completed projects.
Perform on-going, periodic tasks related to geospatial database maintenance.
Prepares and submits reports of project updates, as needed.
Performs a wide variety of advanced process and analysis functions to develop the City's geographic information system (GIS) and is responsible for its operation, administration and information quality and integrity.
Provides technical consultation to a wide range of technical and non-technical employees using the GIS to compile reports and studies.
Responsible for documentation and ensures the integrity and security of the data stored in the GIS and related/integrated databases.
Key contact for GIS within the project team.
Completion of tasks received from engineers and the GIS manager.
Integration of data from multiple sources into the spatial data repository.
Conducts analysis, interrogation and manipulation of spatial data received from stakeholders and third parties.
cond_0461.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise in ESRI ArcGIS.
Deep expertise in ESRI ArcGIS extensions: 3D, Spatial, Network and Tracking Analyst.
Proven track record of providing GIS support to multidiscipline, client-focused, project environments.
Advanced knowledge of spatial data formats and spatial reference systems.
Strong command of Microsoft Word and Excel.
Proven track record of delivering to deadlines within pressurized environments.
Exceptional communication skills in written and spoken English.
Strong command of database programming languages such as SQL, R or Python.
Strong command of front end design languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and various mapping languages.
Strong ability to analyze problems and perform needs assessments.
Strong judgment in adapting broad guidelines to achieve desired results.
Degree in Computer Science, Geography, Surveying, Engineering or a degree qualification in GIS required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise with mapping tools such as QGIS and Carto.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise with GPS measuring tools.
Minimum 3 years of proven experience working with and controlling a large number of evolving datasets.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise using FME Desktop and Server.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise using AutoCAD software (including Civil 3D and Map).
Minimum 3 years of hands-on expertise using CAD derived data within a GIS environment.
